CheckTitle: Ensure AWS Config is enabled in all regions
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that an AWS Config configuration recorder is recording without failure in every region.
Risk: Without AWS Config, configuration history and drift needed for incident response and compliance evidence are missing.

Code.CLI: aws configservice put-configuration-recorder --configuration-recorder name=default,roleARN=<role> --recording-group allSupported=true,includeGlobalResourceTypes=true && aws configservice start-configuration-recorder --configuration-recorder-name default

Recommendation.Text: Enable an AWS Config recorder (all supported resources, including global resources in one region) in every region.
